title: Beginning
body:
<<set $dialogueEnd to false >>
<<set $tutorialInvestigate to false >>
"…"
"………"
[i]BZZT–![/i]
A loud, unfamiliar alarm jolted me awake, my eyes blinking to adjust to the dimness.
SLOWLY UNFADING BLACK
“What was that alar—"
"...Huh?”
I look around, dumbfounded.
CAMERA PANS AROUND THE SPACE
“Just where the hell am I…”
“This is so not where I last remember falling asleep.”
“Urgh–!”
I put a hand to my head, the beginnings of a headache forming.
“What… is going on..?”
Panic sets in, my heart racing.
I was just at home a minute ago, wasn’t I?
At my desk, writing this godforsaken report on myths of mermaids, sirens more specifically, and I just. Took a nap.
And now I’m here, wherever “here” is.
“O-Oh god, am I kidnapped?”
I looked around at my surroundings again, but it only left me in a daze as confusion began to replace panic.
This space… Certainly doesn’t feel like where you would keep a hostage.
Rather it feels more like a very large fish tank?
“No, regardless… I need to get out of here.”
I have no idea who brought me here, and why, but from my long history of watching mystery anime, there’s always a reason for everything.
...Aaaand the reason I’m here now probably isn’t good.
“Ugh… Escape first, think later!!!”
<<set $dialogueEnd to true >>
<<set $tutorialInvestigate to true >>

title: Tutorial (Investigate)
body:
<<set $dialogueEnd to false >>
Hi. Congratulations, YOU need to figure out how to escape.
To do so, turn around by using the [b]left and right arrow keys[/b].
Since this is a very limited and cramped space, you can only go forward a little, using the [b]up arrow key[/b], to more closely inspect the area.
To inspect anything of interest, [b]hover[/b] over the object with the [b]cursor[/b] and [b]click to interact[/b].
<<set $dialogueEnd to true >>
<<set $tutorialInvestigate to false>>

title: Blue Coral
body:
<<set $dialogueEnd to false >>
Some blue coral. It looks kind of spiky.
What if I broke off a part and sharpened it like a pickaxe, and dug my way out of here…
“...Yeah, that’s probably wishful thinking.”
<<set $dialogueEnd to true >>
